an7.70:1.1: Atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
an7.70:1.2: ‘kin nu kho bhikkhu sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya kusalaṃ bhāveyyā' ti?
an7.70:1.3: Atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa etad ahosi
an7.70:1.4: ‘Satthāraṃ kho bhikkhu sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya kusalaṃ bhāveyya,
an7.70:1.10: paṭisanthāraṃ kho bhikkhu sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya kusalaṃ bhāveyyā' ti.
an7.70:2.1: Atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa etad ahosi
an7.70:2.2: ‘ime kho me dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā; yan nūnāhaṃ ime dhamme gantvā Bhagavato āroceyyaṃ,
an7.70:2.3: evaṃ me ime dhammā parisuddhā c' eva bhavissanti parisuddhasaṃkhātatarā ca.
an7.70:2.4: Seyyathā pi nāma puriso suvaṇṇanikkhaṃ adhigaccheyya parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ,
an7.70:2.6: "ayaṃ kho me suvaṇṇanikkho parisuddho pariyodāto; yan nūnāhaṃ imaṃ suvaṇṇanikkhaṃ gantvā kammārānaṃ dasseyyaṃ,
an7.70:2.7: evaṃ me ayaṃ suvaṇṇanikkho kammāragato parisuddho c' eva bhavissati parisuddhasaṃkhātataro cā"
an7.70:2.8: ti: evam eva me ime dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā; yan nūnāhaṃ ime dhamme gantvā Bhagavato āroceyyaṃ,
an7.70:2.9: evaṃ me ime dhammā parisuddhā c' eva bhavissanti parisuddhasaṃkhātatarā cā' ti.
an7.70:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.

an7.70:5.8: paṭisanthāraṃ kho Sāriputta bhikkhu sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya kusalaṃ bhāveyyā' ti.
an7.70:6.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 3.
an7.70:6.2: Imassa kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
an7.70:6.3: So vata bhante bhikkhu Satthari agāravo dhamme sagāravo bhavissatī ti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati;
an7.70:6.4: yo so bhante bhikkhu Satthari agāravo, dhamme pi so agāravo.
